User Story: As an Engineer, I want to create the complete D1 database schema so that all backend services have a properly structured, migration-versioned data layer aligned with the ERD.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: All 12 tables created in D1 (users, user_roles, resumes, resume_feedback, interview_questions, ai_usage, trade_grad_waitlist, employer_waitlist, contact_submissions, admin_audit_log, email_events, workflow_runs)
AC2: All foreign keys, CHECK constraints, and recommended indexes applied per ERD specification
AC3: Migration file versioned and idempotent (re-runnable without error)

User Story: As an Engineer, I want to configure the R2 storage bucket so that resume PDFs can be stored with user-scoped paths and proper access controls.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: R2 bucket created with private-by-default access policy
AC2: CORS policy configured for the frontend domain
AC3: Worker binding configured for direct R2 access without network hops

User Story: As an Engineer, I want the Worker project scaffolded with all bindings and environment secrets so that services deploy consistently across dev and production.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: wrangler.toml configured with D1, R2, and environment bindings
AC2: Secrets set — Clerk keys, OpenRouter API key, Resend API key
AC3: Local dev environment functional with wrangler dev

User Story: As a User, I want to sign up and sign in using Clerk's authentication components so that I have a secure, modern authentication experience replacing the current Supabase Auth forms.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: ClerkProvider wraps the React application with correct publishable key
AC2: Sign-in and Sign-up pages render Clerk pre-built components
AC3: Session state accessible via Clerk's useAuth() / useUser() hooks
AC4: ProtectedRoute component updated to use Clerk session check

User Story: As the System, I want to receive Clerk webhook events so that user records are automatically synced to D1 on every signup, profile update, and deletion.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Worker endpoint receives user.created webhook and inserts into users table
AC2: Worker receives user.updated webhook and updates users record
AC3: Webhook signature verified using Clerk's SVIX library
AC4: If role mapping exists in Clerk metadata, user_roles is upserted

User Story: As the System, I want all authenticated Worker endpoints to verify Clerk JWTs so that only valid, non-expired sessions can access protected resources.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: JWT signature verified against Clerk JWKS endpoint (cached at edge)
AC2: Token expiry validated; expired tokens return 401
AC3: User ID extracted from JWT claims and injected into request context
AC4: Invalid or missing tokens return 401 with descriptive error

User Story: As an Admin, I want role-based access control enforced at the Worker level so that only users with the admin role can access admin-only endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Middleware queries user_roles table for the authenticated user
AC2: Non-admin users receive 403 Forbidden
AC3: Admin check reusable across all admin Worker routes

User Story: As a User, I want to upload my resume as a PDF so that I can receive AI-powered feedback and use it for interview prep.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: File validation — PDF only, max 5 MB
AC2: PDF stored in R2 under user-scoped path ({user_id}/resume.pdf)
AC3: SHA-256 hash computed server-side for deduplication
AC4: Metadata record created in D1 resumes table
AC5: Previous active resume set to is_active = 0
AC6: Frontend re-wired from Supabase Storage to Worker upload endpoint

User Story: As a User, I want to see my uploaded resume details so that I know what file is currently active and its feedback status.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Display file name, upload date, file size
AC2: Show feedback status badge (Uploaded / Pending Review / Feedback Ready)
AC3: Scoped by authenticated user's ID

User Story: As a User, I want to delete my resume so that I can remove outdated files and upload a new version.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: R2 object deleted on confirmed removal
AC2: D1 record soft-deleted (deactivated) to preserve audit trail
AC3: Associated feedback records display 'Resume removed' state

User Story: As a User, I want to generate AI-powered resume feedback so that I receive a scored evaluation with strengths, improvements, and trade-specific suggestions.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Quota check — reject if user has used >= 3 AI actions
AC2: Deduplication check — reject if same resume hash already processed
AC3: Cloudflare Workflow orchestrates 6 durable steps: Validate > Enrich > AI Inference > Normalize > Persist > Notify
AC4: OpenRouter call uses structured tool-call schema forcing JSON output
AC5: Feedback saved to resume_feedback with status = pending_review
AC6: AI usage record created in same D1 transaction
AC7: Workflow retries individual failed steps (max 3, exponential backoff)

User Story: As a User, I want to see my resume feedback once an admin has approved it so that I can act on the evaluation.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Feedback visible only when status = approved
AC2: Display overall score (1-10), strengths, improvements, suggestions, trade-specific suggestions, actionable steps
AC3: Show 'Pending Review' state when status = pending_review

User Story: As an Admin, I want to review, edit, approve, or reject AI-generated resume feedback so that users only see quality-controlled, human-verified content.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: View full AI output in review modal with all feedback fields
AC2: Approve action sets status = approved, records reviewed_by and reviewed_at
AC3: Reject action sets status = rejected with mandatory rejection_reason
AC4: Edit fields before approval — original AI output preserved in admin_audit_log
AC5: Audit log entry created for each review action

User Story: As a User, I want to generate categorized interview questions from a job description so that I can prepare for trade job interviews.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Job description input validated (min 10 chars, max 2000 chars)
AC2: Quota and deduplication checks
AC3: Cloudflare Workflow generates 3 question categories via OpenRouter
AC4: Questions returned immediately to user — NO admin gate
AC5: Results persisted to interview_questions and usage recorded atomically

User Story: As a User, I want to see my previously generated question sets so that I can revisit my interview prep materials.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Display most recent question set with all 3 categories
AC2: Show total question count and generation date
AC3: Scoped to authenticated user only

User Story: As an Admin, I want to see all submitted resume feedback entries so that I can manage the review queue efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: List all feedback with user name, trade program, status, score, date
AC2: Search by user name or email
AC3: Filter by status (pending_review / approved / rejected)
AC4: Sort by date (newest first default)

User Story: As an Admin, I want to view all waitlist signups so that I can assess market interest and outreach candidates.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Trade grad waitlist tab with search/filter by name, email, trade, location
AC2: Employer waitlist tab with search/filter by name, company, trades hiring for
AC3: Display submission counts per trade program

User Story: As an Admin, I want to export waitlist and feedback data to CSV so that I can analyze it in external tools.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Export trade grad waitlist as CSV with all columns
AC2: Export employer waitlist as CSV
AC3: Export resume feedback as CSV
AC4: Filename includes export timestamp

User Story: As an Admin, I want to see the audit trail of all administrative actions so that governance and accountability are traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Chronological list of all admin actions
AC2: Each entry shows actor, action type, target entity, timestamp
AC3: Filter by action type (approve, reject, edit, export, grant_role)

User Story: As a Visitor, I want to sign up for the trade graduate waitlist so that I get early access to Kraftworks when the career fair launches.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Form fields — full name, email, trade program (dropdown), state, city, consent
AC2: Validation — required fields enforced, valid email format
AC3: Record saved to D1 trade_grad_waitlist via unauthenticated Worker
AC4: Confirmation email sent via Resend
AC5: Success message displayed

User Story: As a Visitor (employer), I want to sign up for the employer waitlist so that I can hire trade graduates when the platform launches.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Form fields — full name, job title, company email, trades hiring for, hiring volume, state, city, consent
AC2: Record saved to D1 employer_waitlist
AC3: Confirmation email sent via Resend

User Story: As a Visitor, I want to submit a contact inquiry so that I can reach Kraftworks for questions, partnerships, or support.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Contact form with name, email, subject (optional), message
AC2: Submission persisted to D1 contact_submissions with status = new
AC3: Admin notification email sent via Resend
AC4: Success confirmation shown to user

User Story: As the System, I want Resend fully configured so that Workers can send transactional emails with production-grade deliverability.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Resend API key configured as Worker secret
AC2: Sender domain verified with SPF, DKIM, DMARC records
AC3: Reusable email-sending helper function available to all Workers

User Story: As the System, I want professional email templates for all notification types so that communications are consistent and branded.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Admin notification template — new resume feedback submission
AC2: User confirmation template — waitlist signup acknowledgment
AC3: Contact inquiry acknowledgment template

User Story: As a User, I want to see my dashboard with resume status, AI usage progress, and interview prep history so that I have a single view of my career readiness.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Resume card — file name, upload date, feedback status badge
AC2: AI usage card — progress bar showing remaining actions (X of 3)
AC3: Interview prep card — latest question set summary
AC4: All data fetched from Worker API endpoints

User Story: As a User, I want to see my remaining AI actions displayed prominently so that I make informed decisions before using an AI feature.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1: Display 'X of 3 remaining' with visual progress indicator
AC2: Usage list shows action type and date
AC3: Real-time count update after each AI action completes
